criteria.name: Problem Understanding & Data Quality
criteria.guidance: Assess problem framing, target definition, data structure, and data quality.

criteria.name: EDA & Feature Engineering
criteria.guidance: Assess analysis, visualization, cleaning, encoding, and feature engineering.

criteria.name: Model Development
criteria.guidance: Assess algorithm choice, pipeline, split strategy, and leakage avoidance.

criteria.name: Evaluation & Business Interpretation
criteria.guidance: Assess suitable metrics, validation, interpretation, and recommendations.

criteria.name: Reproducibility & Communication
criteria.guidance: Assess code organization, clarity, limitations, and reproducibility evidence.
